info.name: Set a terminal configuration for a store

params.name: store_id
params.description: The store the configuration applies to

items.docs: Sets a configuration value for the store. The value applies to all terminals in the store. Valid values depend on the config_key - for example, PAT_ENABLED accepts true or false; other values return 400. Calling this endpoint again with the same value has no additional effect.

### No Permission Required - This is an endpoint that does not require permission
---

Retrieves all stores for a given merchant.

**Required Scopes (one of the following):**

- `stores/id/terminals` (returned via the register API: `POST /poslink/v1/epos/register`)
- `default_access` (deprecated, will be removed in the future; included for backward compatibility with existing integrations)

info.name: Retrieve configurations for a terminal scoped to a store

params.name: store_id
params.description: The store the terminal belongs to

params.name: terminal_id
params.description: The terminal whose configurations are being fetched

items.docs: Returns all configurations for the store. The terminal_id is recorded so future configuration updates can be pushed to this terminal.
